reviews.text:
I cannot recommend Buster & Whiskers enough! As an owner of a people reactive dog, I was so stressed to find a dog walker that could handle and is willing to work with my dog’s quirks. Igor immediately put my nerves at ease with his deep knowledge of dog behavior and experience with a wide variety of dogs.
He trains all of his dog walkers to handle each dog and provides an individualized approach. Though they cannot guarantee the same walker everyday, they are all trained on the same walking approach.
Also, they are extremely organized and use an app for scheduling and communication with the walkers.
I am so grateful to have found Busters & Whiskers!!

Buster and Whiskers has been a wonderful part of our dog’s daily life for the past year, since we rescued her.

We know Kona loves her dog walkers, especially Leonard and David, because when we get home there’s always a toy at the door - she only brings a toy to the people she loves when they come in!

B&W is communicative and always looks out for the best interest of the pups - thank you, Jen and Igor!

Great team they have here. Tyson loves going on his long walks (2x a day, an hour each) he has his walking buddies and the staff is so incredibly friendly, helpful and reliable. You can trust that they will take care of your best friend, I cannot imagine using a different company. I love receiving pictures from their walks. Thank you Buster and Whiskers for being good to my big boy.

We love Buster and Whiskers. All their walkers are sweet and patient with our anxious corgi. They also keep us in the loop via an app with photos of our pup. Highly recommend!

We were initially hesitant to try a dog walking service because our dogs, Loki and Ary, are quite strong and can be a handful. It was hard for us to trust anyone to handle them. However, Eduardo, Ricardo, and Garrett have completely won us …

The whole team at Buster and Whiskers is great! From day one, they were wonderful with our dog. The after walk pics and messages were appreciated, Jen and Igor were quick to answer if any questions, and we always felt comfortable having our dog with them. Will always recommend them!

Amazing team! Sansa waits them at the door when it’s close to the time when they come to pick her up for the walk and always comes back so happy! She loves them! Igor and Jen are great, very experienced, professional and attentive. There’s no other dog walking company better than Busters & Whiskers in Astoria. They are the best!
